Torrents are what everyone looks for and are really vulnerable to monitoring due to the nature of torrent swarms. ISPs only care about low-hanging fruit and doing just enough not to get bitched at by media companies, so pretty much any effort will keep them off of your back.

For music, Spotify and Pandora are always options. If you prefer your music downloaded (and/or pirated), Soulseek is a system that works similarly to how Napster worked (person to person direct transfers), but never drew enough heat to get shut down. They have pretty much anything you could want music-wise, including a bunch of stuff that would be too obscure to keep seeds with torrents.

For TV shows/Movies, streaming sites have served me well. Project Free TV (knock-offs now, but they work), PrimeWire, and Putlocker are all decent choices. For animation/anime, Kiss Cartoon/Anime are spectacular sites, and work well on mobile which is rare for illicit streaming sites. You can also straight up google "Watch [SHOW NAME}]" and find somewhere to watch it, just avoid any downloads and use a good ad blocker.
